title: ConfigReach Curated 50K Benchmark
subtitle: 50,000 balanced config-input detection scenarios across 24 technology groups
description: A reproducible controlled benchmark for configuration-input detection. It contains 50,000 deterministic labeled scenarios, balanced 25,000 positive and 25,000 negative, spanning 24 programming-language and configuration-format groups. Includes the canonical scenario JSONL, row-level ConfigReach predictions, integrity manifest, and benchmark summary. This is a controlled curated benchmark, not independently human-labelled real-world data. Licensed under the MIT License; Kaggle license is marked as Other because MIT is not a native Kaggle dataset-license option.

resources.description: Canonical 50,000-row labeled ConfigReach benchmark in JSON Lines format.
Row-level ConfigReach predictions with expected/actual detection and TP/FP/TN/FN classification.
Integrity metadata including class balance, group counts, byte size, and SHA-256.
